_comment: AutoForm view spec for the FCS channel-definition editor (PRD-40 uniformity port). All user-facing strings under label/description/title/add_label/placeholder/remove_label/labels/columns[].label are auto-translated via chisurf.core.i18n.tr at parse time and are picked up by build_tools/i18n/extract_strings.py.

sections.label: Detector setup
sections.description: Detector setup whose logical channels are paired for correlation. Detector setups are managed in the channel-definition wizard.

sections.label: Public
sections.description: When checked, this setup is visible to all users in the MMFDB. Only the owner can change this setting.

buttons.label: 🔄 Reload
buttons.description: Reload the detector setups from disk.

buttons.label: 💾 Save
buttons.description: Save the channel-pair definitions for this detector setup.
